question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Anonymity
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Anonymity"** means the condition of being anonymous; the state of having an unknown or unacknowledged name or identity. (गुमनामी)

 
 
• **Example: **The whistleblower requested** anonymity** to avoid any potential backlash.
 
 
 
• **"Importance" **refers to the state or fact of being of great significance or value. (महत्व)
 
 
• **Example: **The** importance** of education cannot be overstated in today's world.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Anonymity' **is **'Importance'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Cachet **(प्रतिष्ठा): The state of being respected or admired; prestige.

 
 
• **Example:** Winning the award gave her a certain cachet in the industry.
 
 
 
• **Silence **(चुप्पी): The absence of sound or noise.
 
 
• **Example: **The silence in the library was almost tangible.
 
 
 
• **Bareness** (निर्जनता): The state of being bare or empty.
 
 
• **Example:** The bareness of the room made it look quite uninviting.
 
 

30:Taaf,

The correct answer is: **Option 4.**
